question: What will be the average daily mean temperature in Beijing over the 7 days ending September 7, 2026, in degrees Celsius?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the mean of the daily mean 2-metre air temperatures from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-07 at latitude 39.9, longitude 116.4 (Beijing), from the ERA5 reanalysis as served by the Open-Meteo historical weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com), in degrees Celsius.
research:
I've finished pulling the Open-Meteo data and searching the news; here is the summary.

## 1. Resolution source
- The resolving series is Open-Meteo's ERA5 archive (`archive-api.open-meteo.com`), daily `temperature_2m_mean` at 39.9, 116.4. Calls with no timezone set default to GMT/UTC days. The question doesn't name a timezone, and Asia/Shanghai days can shift the result by a few tenths of a degree. For 2016 the Shanghai-time mean was 23.1 °C. [Open-Meteo](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2016-09-01&end_date=2016-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai)
- The latest values on or before the cutoff, in °C (GMT days): Aug 17: 27.1, Aug 18: 27.3, Aug 19: 27.4, Aug 20: 27.5, Aug 21: 28.4, Aug 22: 27.8, Aug 23: 27.4, Aug 24: 27.8. The most recent days may still be preliminary (ERA5T or model-filled) values. [Open-Meteo](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2026-08-10&end_date=2026-08-24&daily=temperature_2m_mean)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet, since the window (Sep 1-7) hasn't started.
- 2026-08-24: Beijing has been warm going into the window. Aug 17-24 averaged about 27.6 °C in this series, compared with about 25.8 °C for Aug 17-24, 2025. Aug 10-24 averaged about 26.9 °C in 2026 and 26.0 °C in 2025. [Open-Meteo 2025](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2025-08-10&end_date=2025-08-24&daily=temperature_2m_mean)

## 3. Recent news
- I couldn't find a Beijing 10-day forecast or an early-September outlook published around Aug 20-24, 2026.
- 2026-08-23: the extended "sanfu" hottest period (40 days, Jul 15 to Aug 23) ended. [gmw.cn](https://m.gmw.cn/2026-08/05/content_1304543253.htm)
- 2026-08-06: Beijing Meteorological Observatory said hot, humid weather would continue, with highs up to 36 °C. [gmw.cn](https://m.gmw.cn/2026-08/06/content_1304543938.htm)
- 2026-08-05: forecast of highs around 36 °C on the plains for Aug 5-7, with afternoon thunderstorms. [gmw.cn](https://m.gmw.cn/2026-08/05/content_1304543253.htm)
- 2026-08-02: frequent thunderstorms, highs of 32-34 °C, humid. [gmw.cn](https://m.gmw.cn/2026-08/02/content_1304541626.htm)

## 4. Base rates
Sep 1-7 mean from the same API and grid point (GMT days):
- 2016: about 23.1 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2016-09-01&end_date=2016-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai) (Shanghai days)
- 2017: 22.86 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2017-09-01&end_date=2017-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2018: 23.54 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2018-09-01&end_date=2018-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2019: 26.64 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2019-09-01&end_date=2019-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2020: 23.59 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2020-09-01&end_date=2020-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2021: 21.8 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2021-09-01&end_date=2021-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2022: 21.64 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2022-09-01&end_date=2022-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2023: 25.01 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2023-09-01&end_date=2023-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2024: 22.7 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2024-09-01&end_date=2024-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)
- 2025: 25.13 [link](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=39.9&longitude=116.4&start_date=2025-09-01&end_date=2025-09-07&daily=temperature_2m_mean)

What the 10 years show:
- **Average and spread:** the 10-year mean is about 23.6 °C, with a standard deviation of about 1.6 °C. The range runs from 21.6 (2022) to 26.6 (2019), and there's no clear trend.
- **Position against the question's range (23.5 to 33.0):** 5 of 10 years came in below the 23.5 lower bound, and 2018 (23.54) sat right on it. None came close to 33.
- **Swings within the week:** single cold-air outbreaks can drop daily means by 3-5 °C, for example 26.8 to 21.7 on Sep 4-5, 2025, and 21.8 to 17.6 on Sep 5-6, 2021.
- **Persistence:** late-August warmth only partly carries over. 2025's late August was cooler than 2026's, and its Sep 1-7 still came in at 25.1.
- Normally, daily means fall by roughly 1 °C between late August and the first week of September.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I couldn't find any Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question, or any published expert or CMA outlook for Beijing's Sep 1-7 temperature dated on or before 2026-08-24.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Medium-range model runs (ECMWF and GFS, for example through the Open-Meteo forecast API) covering Sep 1-7 will become informative from about Aug 25-28. The key thing to watch is the timing of the first autumn cold-air outbreak from Mongolia or Siberia, which usually marks the start of autumn in Beijing (the 1991-2020 average autumn onset is mid-September).
- The ERA5 values for Sep 1-7 should be finalized in the archive by about Sep 12-13, in line with the stated resolution date.
